name: Michael Flynn

summary.text: Michael Flynn is a retired U.S. Army lieutenant general who served briefly as national security adviser in 2017. An amended financial disclosure released by the White House in August 2017 listed him as an adviser to a Virginia-based SCL Group entity, described by the Associated Press as the parent of Cambridge Analytica; SCL told the AP the advisory work never materialized.
